queries: Altman Three Observations scaling laws February 2025

sources_considered.why: OpenAI's CEO stated his view of scaling laws on February 9, 2025, four days before the post. Context only, because the claim has no settled reading.

receipt.public_excerpt: These resources are chiefly training compute, data, and inference compute. It appears that you can spend arbitrary amounts of money and get continuous and predictable gains; the scaling laws that predict this are accurate over many orders of magnitude.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI's CEO still backed scaling laws in February 2025, which cuts against the 'abandoned' reading. But he added inference compute to data and training compute, which partly fits Marcus's point. The evidence does not settle a rhetorical claim.

unresolved_gaps: Marcus did not say whether 'dead' means disproven or abandoned, and there is no agreed test for either reading.
